hook: New Zealand still doesn't know who won
caption:
🇳🇿 New Zealand's election is too close to call: wait for special votes before trusting any winner claims.
🕊️ Ukraine, Russia and the US hold three-way talks in Abu Dhabi on 10–11 November.
🏛️ Democrats won both the House and Senate in the US midterms.
🤝 NZ's two big parties may need smaller ones to govern.
🪑 Fun fact: NZ's parliament can grow beyond 120 seats.
Which story surprised you most?

1/5 NZ vote: too close to call (99.7%)
New Zealand's 7 November election is still too close to call. Now everyone waits for the special votes to be counted.
📷 Donaldytong (CC BY-SA 3.0) via wikimedia

2/5 Ukraine talks set for Abu Dhabi (3-way)
Ukraine, Russia and US talk in Abu Dhabi, 10–11 November. First direct three-way talks since February, on ending the war.
📷 Clint Ian Pinto (CC BY-SA 4.0) via wikimedia

3/5 Democrats take both chambers (Both)
Democrats won the House and Senate in the 3 November midterms. It means a Democratic Congress facing a Republican president.
📷 Martin Falbisoner (CC BY-SA 3.0) via wikimedia

4/5 NZ's big two may need help
National and Labour may struggle to govern without smaller parties. Coalition talks could decide who governs, not just the count.
🎨 AI-generated image

5/5 A parliament that can grow (120+)
NZ's parliament has 120 seats, plus extra 'overhang' seats. So the majority line can shift with each election.
